definitions.full: H5783. ur II. [ עוּר ] verb be exposed, bare (akin to ערר עָרָה, ; Arabic = pudenda ); — Niph`al Imperfect 3feminine singular קַשְׁתֶּ֑ךְ תֵעוֺר עֶרְיָה Hab 3:9 into nakedness (i.e. utterly) is thy bow laid bare , made ready; We proposes תְּעוֺרֵר עוֺרֵר (compare 2Sam 23:18 , I. עור Po`l. ), and so Now [from √ ערר , lay bare ] thou layest , etc.
